shared_elements: horizontal register or band across the surface
justification: A depicts a specific iconographic scene: a procession of five standing human figures in profile carrying bowls and offerings, one clasping the hand of the leading figure, beneath a band of rosettes; B shows no identifiable figures or motifs at all, only faint horizontal lines of what may be inscription-like ruling on eroded rock. The only shared feature is the vague sense of horizontal registers, which is far too generic to indicate any common iconographic tradition.
